components.note: 子 (child) — marks children and offspring, as in 孩 child, 学 study, 字; 孙 is a grandchild, the child of a child.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 把 is to grasp.
巴 (bā) gives the sound: 把 bǎ is close, as in 爸 bà and 吧 ba.
贝 (shell, old money) — marks money and trade, as in 财, 货, 贵; 贩 is to trade goods.
反 (fǎn) hints at the sound: 贩 fàn is close to 饭 fàn.
钅 (metal, from 金) — marks metals, as in 铁, 钱, 银; 钓 is to fish with a metal hook.
勺 (sháo) is only a loose sound hint for diào.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 摸; 抚 is to stroke or soothe with the hand.
无 (wú) is only a loose sound hint for fǔ.
艹 (plants) — marks plants, as in 花, 草, 茶; 蒂 is the stem of a fruit or flower.
帝 (dì) gives the sound exactly: 蒂 dì, also in 啼 tí and 缔 dì.
口 (mouth) — marks speech and spoken particles, as in 吗, 呢, 吧; 啦 is a lively final particle.
拉 (lā) gives the sound exactly: 啦 lā.
兽 (simplified 獸) — the old form paired a hunted animal with a dog 犬; it means beast, as in 野兽 and 怪兽.
石 (stone) — marks stone, as in 破, 码, 砖; 础 is a foundation stone.
出 (chū) hints at the sound: 础 chǔ is close.
酉 (wine jar) — marks liquor and fermentation, as in 酒 liquor, 醉 drunk, 醒 sober; 酷 is strong, then harsh and cool.
告 (gào) is a loose hint for kù; 靠 kào and 浩 hào share it.
辶 (movement) — marks walking and travel, as in 过, 进, 送; 返 is to go back.
反 (fǎn) gives the sound exactly: 返 fǎn, and 反 also means opposite.
羊 (sheep) — 羞 first meant offering food (a sheep dish) by hand; the sense of shame came later, as in 害羞.
氵 (water) — marks water, as in 河, 海, 湖; 池 is a pond.
也 (yě) hints at the sound: 池 chí is close to 驰 chí and 弛 chí.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk, as in 说, 话, 谎; 诡 is sly, deceitful talk.
危 (wēi) is a loose hint for guǐ; 跪 guì shares it.
疒 (illness) — marks sickness and pain, as in 病, 痛, 疗; 疼 is to ache.
冬 (dōng) hints at the sound: 疼 téng is close.
门 (gate) — marks gates and doors, as in 问, 间, 开; 闪 is a person 人 glimpsed through a gate: a flash, to dodge.
禾 (grain) — marks grain and crops, as in 秋, 种, 租; 积 is grain piled up, to accumulate.
只 (zhī) hints at the sound: 积 jī is close, and 只 also gives 织 zhī and 识 shí.
口 (mouth) — marks speech and spoken particles, as in 吗, 吧, 啊; 呢 is a question or emphasis particle.
尼 (ní) gives the sound: 呢 ne/ní, also in 泥 ní.
予 (yǔ) — to give; as a part it sounds out 预 yù, 野 yě and 序 xù.
口 (mouth) — marks speech and breath, as in 吃, 叫, 喝; 呵 is a laugh or a breath out.
可 (kě) hints at the sound: 呵 hē is close, and 可 also gives 河 hé, 歌 gē and 何 hé.
京 (jīng) — capital, drawn as a tall building on a mound; as a part it sounds out 景 jǐng, 惊 jīng, 鲸 jīng and 凉 liáng.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk, as in 说, 话, 请; 诱 is to coax with words.
秀 (xiù) hints at the sound: 诱 yòu is close to 透 tòu and 锈 xiù.
辶 (movement) — marks walking and meeting, as in 过, 进, 送; 遭 is to meet, usually with bad luck.
曹 (cáo) hints at the sound: 遭 zāo is close to 糟 zāo and 槽 cáo.
⺮ (bamboo) — marks bamboo and things made of it, as in 笔, 筷, 篮; 箭 is an arrow, shaft of bamboo.
前 (qián) hints at the sound: 箭 jiàn is close to 剪 jiǎn and 煎 jiān.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 扯 is to tear or pull.
止 (zhǐ) is a loose hint for chě.
衤 (clothing) — marks garments, as in 衬, 衫, 裤; 袜 is a sock.
末 (mò) is a loose hint for wà.
心 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 想, 怒, 思; 惹 stirs up anger or trouble.
若 (ruò) hints at the sound: 惹 rě is close to 诺 nuò.
忄 (heart) — marks feelings, as in 情, 怕, 烦; 恼 is annoyance. The right side matches 脑 nǎo (brain) and gives the sound.
车 (cart, vehicle) — marks wheeled things, as in 转, 车, 较; 轮 is a wheel.
仑 (lún) gives the sound exactly: 轮 lún, also in 论 lùn and 伦 lún.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿, 脑; 胎 is a fetus, and by extension a tyre.
台 (tái) gives the sound exactly: 胎 tāi is close.
氵 (water) — marks water and liquids, as in 河, 海, 汤; with 目 eye it is water from the eye: tears.
目 (eye) — the source, as in 看, 眼, 睡.
亻 (person) — marks people and their actions, as in 你, 做, 休; 倾 is a person leaning over, to tilt or pour out.
顷 (qǐng) hints at the sound: 倾 qīng is close.
贝 (shell, old money) — marks money and gifts, as in 财, 货, 贵; 赞 is to help or praise, as with a gift.
口 (mouth) — marks the mouth and speech, as in 吃, 喝, 吹; 唇 is the lip.
辰 (chén) hints at the sound: 唇 chún is close to 晨 chén and 振 zhèn.
矛 — a picture of a spear with its pointed head; in 矛盾 it pairs with 盾 shield: the old tale of the seller who boasted of both.
盾 (shield) — a shield held in front of the face; pairs with 矛 spear in 矛盾. 盾 dùn also sounds out 遁 dùn.
纟 (silk thread, from 糸) — marks thread and ties, as in 线, 红, 约; 缘 first meant a hem, then the tie of fate.
彖 (tuàn) is only a loose hint for yuán.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 振 is to shake or rouse.
辰 (chén) hints at the sound: 振 zhèn is close to 震 zhèn, which shares it.
又 (hand) — 双 (simplified 雙) shows two birds held in one hand: a pair; the simplified form just doubles the hand 又又.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿, 脑; 胞 is the womb, then a cell (细胞).
包 (bāo) gives the sound exactly: 胞 bāo, also in 饱 bǎo and 抱 bào.
阝 (hill, from 阜) — marks slopes and ranks, as in 院, 阶, 防; 阵 is a battle formation.
车 (chariot) — war chariots lined up in rows.
肖 (xiāo) — to resemble; as a part it sounds out 消 xiāo, 销 xiāo, 宵 xiāo and 俏 qiào.
革 (leather) — marks hides and straps, as in 鞋, 靴 boots, 鞭 whip; 勒 is to rein in or tighten.
力 (lì) is only a loose sound hint for lè.
虫 (insect) — marks insects, as in 蜂 bee, 蚊, 蜘; wax comes from bees, hence 蜡.
昔 (xī) is a loose hint for là; 腊 là shares it.
火 (fire) — marks fire and light, as in 灯, 烧, 燃; 烛 is a candle. The 虫 stands in for an old part 蜀 (shǔ) that gave the sound.
辶 (movement) — marks walking and speed, as in 过, 进, 送; 迅 is rapid.
卂 (xùn) gives the sound exactly: 迅 xùn, also in 讯 xùn.
木 (wood) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树, 桥, 板; 棺 is a wooden coffin.
官 (guān) gives the sound exactly: 棺 guān, also in 馆 guǎn and 管 guǎn.
辶 (movement) — marks roads and travel, as in 过, 进, 送; 途 is a road or route.
余 (yú) is a loose hint for tú; 涂 tú shares it.
亻 (person) — a person 亻 beside two 二: kindness is how people treat each other. 仁 rén also sounds like 人 rén.
阝 (hill, from 阜) — marks mounds and earth, as in 院, 阶, 防; 隧 is a passage dug through a hill.
遂 (suì) gives the sound exactly: 隧 suì.
